vetSays.line: 🛡️ Kelsey, Lauren, Mona, Gino and Rosa met them at the door — 5 put down. Kelsey, Lauren, Mona, Gino, Rosa are hurt.
🛡️ Lauren, Finn, Mona and Rosa met them at the door — 2 put down, 2 driven off. Lauren, Finn, Rosa are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Caleb just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Lauren, Finn, Mona and Adaeze met them at the door — 2 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Lauren, Finn, Mona are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Gino just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Mona, Adaeze, Rosa, Caleb and Nadia met them at the door — 2 put down, 3 driven off. Mona, Adaeze, Rosa, Caleb, Nadia are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Aroha just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Larry just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Zoltan just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Larry and Zoltan met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Larry is hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Larry just put down The Loud Beast... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Larry taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: European Elder — named and noted.
Lauren showed Nadia the European Elder — "remember it." The haven hears about it by supper.
Larry drew European Elder in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Larry just put down The Loud Thing... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Emma just put down The Eulogy... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Trond and Emma met them at the door — 1 put down. Trond didn't come back.
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Njuguna just put down Big-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Njuguna and Nathan met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Nathan is hurt.
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
